term: proximate matter and form in the H.6 unity reply
definition: The proximate material and formal aspects characterized at 1045b17–21 as same and one, the former potentially and the latter actually. This is a proposed explanation of unity through potentiality/actuality, not two independent actual objects tied together and not a modern equation identifying all matter and form.
